create_categorical_distribution: create a Categorical distribution from logits or probs using distrax Categorical class
sample_from_categorical: sample random category indices from a Categorical distribution using the sample method
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of given values under a Categorical distribution
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two Categorical distributions with matching category counts
compute_entropy: compute the entropy of a Categorical distribution and its gradients via JAX
